- memory_id "1000975" [constraint]: As of 2026-02-03, the Atlas team does a no-deploy Friday.  (about: Atlas team)

- memory_id "1000808" [constraint]: The billing API has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02, covering the peak season.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000417": INC-2025-011 affected the ledger service on 2025-05-24.  (about: ledger service, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000779": As of 2025-11-04, the billing API depends on the ledger service.  (about: ledger service, billing API)
- memory_id "1000101": As of 2025-01-14, Oskar takes the first Ember team on-call shift of the year.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000160" [constraint]: The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000708" [decision]: As of 2025-09-30, the billing API will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch.  (about: billing API, feature-flags, new invoice flow)
